name: Honjou Motonaga
source:
"Natural history and entomology are fields that don't receive much research funding."

The eerie owner of the mansion the protagonist visits.
He is always concerned about his wife, Riko.
He used to study insects and related topics.

[Translated from the [url=https://blackutopia777.wixsite.com/blackutopia/lt-]official website[/url]]
